races.race_name: CELEBRATING 50 YEARS OF THE HK SEVENS 1000M HANDICAP
races.narrative: Race 1: CELEBRATING 50 YEARS OF THE HK SEVENS 1000M HANDICAP — 1000m, Class 5, going G. Early lead: Macanese Master, Always My Folks. Always My Folks (#6) won led throughout, defeating Macanese Master by 1-1/4 with Spicy Spangle third at SP 4.9. Veterinary: Always My Folks (P1) — scoped blood in trachea post-race. Forgive: Oriental Surprise (P8) wide no cover; Fortune Warrior (P12) wide no cover.

horses.incident_text: After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on ALWAYS MY FOLKS at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ALWAYS MY FOLKS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  After the 400 Metres was steadied when held up for clear running behind LUCKY GENERATIONS.  As a result TAIHANG SCENERY was held up until near the 300 Metres when it was shifted to the inside of LUCKY GENERATIONS to secure clear running.
No report.
No report.

After the 400 Metres was steadied to avoid RUN YES RUN.  J Moreira reported that his mount did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to hold a more forward position and finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
No report.

races.race_name: CELEBRATING 40 YEARS OF THE HKFC10s 1650M HANDICAP
races.narrative: Race 2: CELEBRATING 40 YEARS OF THE HKFC10s 1650M HANDICAP — 1650m, Class 5, going G. Early lead: Power Summit, Wah May Wai Wai. Family Fortune (#6) won from the back, defeating Double Bingo by SH with Zetta Force third at SP 4.3. Veterinary: My Flying Angel (PNone) — needs to pass vet exam before racing again. Forgive: Perfecto Moments (P4) wide no cover; Wah May Wai Wai (P5) wide no cover; Smart Trio (P8) wide no cover.

horses.incident_text: After the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid DRAGON SUNRISE when being shifted in behind that runner.  Near the 900 Metres improved to the inside of INNO CENTURY and as a result made contact with that runner.  Near the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid INNO CENTURY.  Approaching the 150 Metres was shifted to the outside of WAH MAY WAI WAI to continue into clear running and as a result made contact with ZETTA FORCE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Shorty after the start was bumped by SMART TRIO which shifted out.  For a short distance near the 250 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  Bumped near the 150 Metres and then raced tight between FAMILY FORTUNE and DOUBLE BINGO for a short distance thereafter.
Was left racing wide and without cover from the 700 Metres.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Raced wide and without cover throughout the early stages and from the 900 Metres was ridden forward to obtain a position outside the lead near the 700 Metres.  Near the 600 Metres shifted in and made contact with POWER SUMMIT.

Approaching the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid INNO CENTURY.  Near the 800 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid SMART TRIO when that runner gave ground.  Z Purton stated that after being steadied near the 800 Metres his mount was obliged to race wide throughout the event and as a result finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 300 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between ZETTA FORCE and EXCEED THE WISH which shifted out.  After being shifted to the inside of EXCEED THE WISH near the 250 Metres FLOOF had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 200 Metres and the 150 Metres when improving between EXCEED THE WISH and POWER SUMMIT which was giving ground.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  When the pace steadied near the 900 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid ZETTA FORCE which shifted out.  Near the 250 Metres was steadied to avoid FLOOF when FLOOF shifted to the inside of EXCEED THE WISH.  After the 150 Metres raced tight to the inside of POWER SUMMIT which was giving ground.

Bumped near the 600 Metres.  Over the concluding stages was eased when racing tight to the inside of FLOOF which was taken in by WAH MAY WAI WAI.  J Orman stated that with the horse stepping up in distance he was asked to take up a forward position.  Trainer D Eustace confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Bumped near the 900 Metres.  Approaching the 800 Metres was steadied when crowded between ZETTA FORCE (C L Chau) which shifted to the outside of FLOOF and SMART TRIO which gave ground at that point when being steadied.  C L Chau was reprimanded.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Withdrawn on 14.4.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter COURIER MAGIC.  Before being allowed to race again, MY FLYING ANGEL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

races.narrative: Race 3: WINNING TRY 1650M HANDICAP — 1650m, Class 4, going G. Early lead: Lakeshore Hero, Viva Firecracker. Fantastic Fun (#1) won from midfield, defeating Run Run Timing by 3/4 with Viva Firecracker third at SP 3.8. Forgive: The Azure (P8) wide no cover; To Infinity (P9) wide no cover; Kolachi (P10) wide no cover; Win Ease (P12) wide no cover.

horses.incident_text: Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted in at the start and made contact with WIN EASE.  K Teetan stated that the instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He said when his mount jumped well and was caught wide he was obliged to hold a more forward position than instructed.  He added in the early stages of the Home Straight his mount was racing greenly and lay in.  He said when contacted on the shoulder by LAKESHORE HERO, VIVA FIRECRACKER became badly unbalanced as a consequence.
No report.

Bumped with THE AZURE on jumping due to both runners shifting ground.  M F Poon stated that after the 300 Metres he endeavoured to improve to the outside of FRANTANCK to obtain clear running.  He said as he did so LAKESHORE HERO lay in which required him to make more effort to shift his mount out.  He said when improving to the outside of FRANTANCK, LAKESHORE HERO made contact with VIVA FIRECRACKER which resulted in VIVA FIRECRACKER becoming badly unbalanced and LAKESHORE HERO then having to be steadied to avoid FRANTANCK.  M F Poon was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.  After being shifted to the inside of FRANTANCK to obtain clear running LAKESHORE HERO was then held up for clear running between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.

Jumped only fairly and then made contact with LAKESHORE HERO due to both runners shifting ground.  Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres raced tight between TAKE ACTION and RED BRICK WARRIOR which was being shifted out to obtain clear running.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded by RUN RUN TIMING which shifted out.  H Bentley stated that his mount had difficulty improving on the Home Turn when positioned behind TO INFINITY and once clear in the Home Straight finished the race off only fairly under riding.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped shortly after the start.  A short distance later was steadied when crowded between VIVA FIRECRACKER which shifted out slightly and THE AZURE which was racing tight to the inside of LAKESHORE HERO.
On jumping was bumped by VIVA FIRECRACKER which shifted in and away from STATE SECURITY.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Between the 200 Metres and the 150 Metres ENTHRALLED then had some difficulty obtaining clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 300 Metres NOBLE PURSUIT (J Moreira) shifted out to improve, resulting in CAN’T GO WONG being taken out slightly but then having to be checked to avoid FOREVER GLORIOUS when that runner commenced to give ground.  As the Stewards were satisfied that Jockey Moreira was entitled to shift out prior to the 300 Metres no action was taken.  As a result CAN’T GO WONG was then badly held up for clear running between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres.

horses.incident_text: Sent for sampling post-race.

races.narrative: Race 6: RACING WITH RUGBY 1200M HANDICAP — 1200m, Class 4, going G. Early lead: Storming Dragon, Golden Empire. Storming Dragon (#3) won led throughout, defeating Cloud Nine by 1 with Motor third at SP 7.5. Veterinary: Northern Fire Ball (PNone) — needs to pass vet exam before racing again. Forgive: Prestige Hall (P6) denied clear running; Next Fortune (P9) wide no cover; Flying Christie (P10) wide no cover.

horses.incident_text: When questioned H Bowman stated that he was instructed to endeavour to take up a more forward position than its previous race starts if the horse commenced well.  He said when his mount commenced well he elected to ride it forward to hold an on-pace position, particularly when the expected leader of the event NORTHERN FIRE BALL had been withdrawn at the Start.  Trainer J Richards confirmed that he had requested Jockey Bowman to ride the horse in a positive manner tonight as STORMING DRAGON was carrying equal top weight of 135 lbs and, in his opinion, it would be difficult to make up ground from back in the field under that weight.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Approaching the 250 Metres made contact with ORIGIN OF FORM when it attempted to shift to the outside of MOTOR to obtain clear running.  After obtaining clear running to the outside of MOTOR passing the 200 Metres QUARTZ LEGEND shifted out, resulting in its rider J Moreira having to stop riding and straighten.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped at the start.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Making the turn after the 1000 Metres was hampered when taken wider by FLYING CHRISTIE. After being shifted to the outside of QUARTZ LEGEND after the 100 Metres PRESTIGE HALL lay in for a short distance and as a result was positioned close to the heels of QUARTZ LEGEND.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

ORIGIN OF FORM then continued to race keenly throughout the early and middle stages.  Bumped approaching the 250 Metres.  Passing the 200 Metres was hampered when taken wider by QUARTZ LEGEND.
Shortly after the start became unbalanced when racing in restricted room between CLOUD NINE and MOTOR, both of which shifted ground.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Sustained superficial abrasions to the right hock whilst being transported to the course, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Jumped only fairly. races.narrative: Race 7: ONE CITY TWO PASSIONS 1200M HANDICAP — 1200m, Class 4, going G. Early lead: Great Looking, World Hero. World Hero (#11) won led throughout, defeating Argento Ocean by 1 with The Heir third at SP 8.2. Forgive: Fatal Blow (P5) wide no cover; Amazing Victory (P8) denied clear running.

horses.incident_text: Blundered on jumping.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 400 Metres shifted in slightly and was bumped on the hindquarters.  Sent for sampling post-race.

As the start was effected lunged forward and made contact with the starting gate.  As a result THE HEIR was slow to begin.  Approaching the 400 Metres was steadied to avoid GREAT LOOKING when that runner was giving ground, resulting in THE HEIR shifting out and making contact with MASTER LUCKY.  Approaching the winning post could not be ridden out when held up behind WORLD HERO.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped shortly after the start.  The Stewards considered a protest/objection lodged by Z Purton, rider of 4th placegetter, RAINBOW SEVEN, against ARGENTO OCEAN being declared 2nd placegetter alleging interference on the Home Turn.  After viewing the videos and considering the evidence the Stewards found that RAINBOW SEVEN became unbalanced near the 400 Metres when crowded for room between GREAT LOOKING which shifted out slightly when giving ground and ARGENTO OCEAN (B Avdulla) which shifted in slightly.  As the Stewards could not be comfortably satisfied that had the interference not have occurred that RAINBOW SEVEN would have finished in advance of ARGENTO OCEAN the protest/objection was overruled and weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  B Avdulla was advised to exercise more care.
Near the 800 Metres was bumped by MASTER LUCKY which shifted out.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start made contact with RAINBOW SEVEN.  Raced keenly throughout the middle stages and for some distance near the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid ARGENTO OCEAN.  In this incident MASTER LUCKY shifted out and made contact with FATAL BLOW. As this was the 3rd consecutive occasion that GREAT LOOKING had finished tailed out, the Stewards ruled that it must perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
